ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon  Assistive Technology Applications Execution Via AtBroker.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the start of a non built-in assistive technology applications via "Atbroker.EXE".

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\AtBroker\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "AtBroker\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*start.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*animations.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*audiodescription.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*caretbrowsing.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*caretwidth.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*colorfiltering.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cursorindicator.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cursorscheme.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*filterkeys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*focusborderheight.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*focusborderwidth.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*highcontrast.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*keyboardcues.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*keyboardpref.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*livecaptions.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*magnifierpane.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*messageduration.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*minimumhitradius.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mousekeys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Narrator.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*osk.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*overlappedcontent.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*showsounds.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*soundsentry.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*speechreco.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*stickykeys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*togglekeys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*voiceaccess.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*windowarranging.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*windowtracking.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*windowtrackingtimeout.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*windowtrackingzorder.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*Oracle\\_JavaAccessBridge.*"))
